description: For saved classification made using unreflected templates. Observed template codes and names are preserved; colors and positions refer to the reflected physical design. Not a synthesis/picklist manifest.
required_section_mirror: After loading, choose Mirror all sections before XY placement: Top ↔ bottom, then Build composite. Leave whole-image mirrors off. Do not apply this remap to classification already rerun with reflected templates.

geometry.array_coordinate_frame: origami-local; rotate clockwise by origami_rotation_degrees_clockwise for upright image display
geometry.bit_meaning: Joint 7-bit codebook identifies color, quadrant and local XY shift.
geometry.bit_order: bit 1 is the most significant bit; bit 7 is the least significant bit
geometry.code_formula: channel_index * x_states * y_states + y_shift * x_states + x_shift
geometry.pixel_mapping: Concatenate quadrant sampling grids; use pixel_centers/edges for nonuniform physical spacing.
geometry.quadrant_offset_convention: field offset plus half the difference between this quadrant's pitch and the first quadrant's pitch
